"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows of name, section and email, sorted by display name."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    if not roster:
        raise ValueError("no students for the contact sheet")
    return [_contact_row(item) for item in roster]


def _contact_row(item: Student) -> str:
    if not item.email:
        raise ValueError(f"no email for {item.display_name}")
    return f"{item.display_name:<20} {item.section:<8} {item.email}"
